title: Find the display names of users who have earned the 'Organizer' badge and o
question: Find the display names of users who have earned the 'Organizer' badge and own at least one post that has a view count above the average and a score among the top 10 highest.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Organizer'
  AND p."XCL_030" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_030") FROM posts)
  AND p."XCL_031" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_031"
    FROM posts
    WHERE "XCL_031" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY "XCL_031" DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )

WITH avg_views AS (
    SELECT AVG("XCL_030") AS avg_view_count
    FROM "posts"
),
top_posts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_033" AS user_id
    FROM "posts"
    WHERE "XCL_030" > (SELECT avg_view_count FROM avg_views)
    ORDER BY "XCL_039" DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM "users" u
INNER JOIN "badges" b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN top_posts tp ON u."XCL_052" = tp.user_id
WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Organizer'
